execution.reference_rule: First declared episode, never selected by outcome

map_selftest.checked: all-hit, fill, eviction; maps, full scratch, LRU and upstream counters

pager_storage.accounting: Scratch/map/CPU masters deduplicated by storage. GPU total is their union, not an additional allocation. CPU master includes its pinned storage, not a second copy.

measured.compilation: No isolated compile timer; process/warmup/first-action timings retained without exclusions

map_initial.accounting: Source-operation counters, not profiler-measured DMA events

map_measurement.accounting: Source-operation counters, not profiler-measured DMA events

map_validation.checked: host inverse and full device map

hardware.boundary: Counter delta covers first-to-last samples inside measurement; unsampled edges remain. Clock/PID samples cannot exclude between-sample excursions. Anonymous pages are process totals, not tensor-specific pinned-master placement; affinity is sampled process allowlist.
